traders_encounter_unexplained_failures_o.meaning: Traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, encounter unexplained failures

assumptions: The zero-cost trade guard is the guard whose trigger condition is described by the intent.
The intent's 'only when' is read as: the guard triggers only in the one-side-receives-without-sending scenario.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric or structural definition of 'one side receives tokens without sending any'; encoded as a grounded Boolean per the intent wording.
The exact zero-cost check expression and its operands are not fully quoted in prose; the disjoint-bits precondition is encoded as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The impact is potential; the outcome symbol records occurrence of unexplained failures without asserting inevitability.
Caller identity and authorization for triggering limit order matching are not stated in the report.

links.reported_relation: The bitwise AND causes the zero-cost guard to falsely trigger when legitimate matched amounts have no overlapping bits, although the guard should only cover one side receiving without sending.
The false zero-cost condition affects all limit order matching, both partial and full matches.
